tasks.name: MapSentenceToFrame_Task
tasks.description: Create a typed frame instance and paraphrase from an input sentence using an ontology and language tools.
tasks.post-condition: exists fi, p (paraphrasesAs(fi, p) and p.text != "")

tasks.name: MakeCommonsenseInference_Task
tasks.description: Given a frame instance and ontology, compute an inference judgement.

tasks.name: CommonsenseReasoning_Skill
tasks.description: End-to-end pipeline: map sentence to frame then evaluate commonsense inference.
tasks.post-condition: exists fi, p, j (paraphrasesAs(fi, p) and judges(fi, j))

tasks.name: commonsense inference
tasks.description: Perform defeasible evaluation on a frame to yield a judgement and entailed sentences.

tasks.name: frame representation mapping
tasks.description: Map a sentence to a frame with filled roles; allow translation for implied actions.
tasks.post-condition: exists fi, p (mapsToFrame(s, fi.frame) and p.text != "")

tasks.name: end-to-end commonsense reasoning
tasks.description: End-to-end pipeline from sentence to inference with examples from KBAI course content.
tasks.post-condition: exists fi, p, j (mapsToFrame(s, fi.frame) and p.text != "" and j.status in {"entailed","plausible","unknown","contradictory"})

examples.sentence: 'Maria told Ben to throw the ball.'

tasks.name: SafetyValidationGoal
tasks.description: Declarative goal to validate world state meets safety constraints for commonsense reasoning outputs.
tasks.post-condition: ok == true  # All safety constraints satisfied (typing, role completeness, non-contradiction)

tasks.name: FailureGoal
tasks.description: Declarative failure goal to register a mechanism failure and surface diagnostics.
